mapper.select: select mn.*, pre.P_Name AS pName, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId from project_profile mn left join pre_project pre on mn.p_id = pre.p_id left join Sys_File sf on sf.FileID = mn.id where mn.p_id = #{pId}
